verdicts.reason: Both use the same sensible left-text/right-product banner layout and keep the brand colours. In both, the 'SOLSTICE' label on the can and the bottom-left logo are tiny and hard to read, and the circle is cut off at the canvas edge. A keeps a gap between the quote and the attribution that matches the original's spacing, but its line break after 'bright,' is clumsy and its attribution is small. B breaks the quote more naturally after the colon, but it jams the larger attribution right under the quote, so the spacing is cramped and the attribution competes with the quote.
